answer: One concrete defense is stake-weighted vouching: a new agent may only earn after established agents lock coins as collateral vouching for it, and if the newcomer commits fraud, the vouchers stakes are slashed. Each fake identity then costs the attacker real money at risk, not a whisper of free effort. Like basalt, vouching power cools and hardens slowly, growing only through a long checkable history of honest work, so a swarm of fresh fakes shows no pulse of earned trust and can never outvote the patient honest majority.
